faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar MTA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position at IIT Ropar is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the MTA post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position is passing the 12th grade.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MTA position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position is up to 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the MTA role at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: You can apply by emailing your detailed CV to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for the position of Multi Tasking Agent (MTA)”.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the MTA position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position is to be discussed with the applicant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MTA recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves CV screening followed by online and in-person interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is hiring for the MTA post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Multi Tasking Agent (MTA) position at IIT Ropar, DRIF.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Ropar, Punjab.
